import parse
from datetime import datetime

# Test various timezone formats
test_cases = [
    ('1997-07-16T19:20+0100', '+01:00'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20+01:00', '+01:00'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20 +01:00', '+01:00'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20-0500', '-05:00'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20-05:00', '-05:00'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20-5:30', '-05:30'),
    ('1997-07-16T19:20-05:30', '-05:30'),
]

for tc, expected_name in test_cases:
    result = parse.parse('{:ti}', tc)
    dt = result[0]
    actual_name = dt.tzinfo._name
    status = 'OK' if actual_name == expected_name else 'FAIL'
    print(f'{tc} -> name={actual_name} (expected {expected_name}) [{status}]')
"
